headline: Monitoring company New Relic has launched AI Evaluation, a tool that scores the quality of an AI application's answers alongside its normal performance data.
score_reason: Kept at pool score 5: a product launch by an established monitoring vendor, described only in the company's own terms.
importance_line: What changed: engineering teams running AI applications get answer-quality scores and security checks in the same tool as their uptime monitoring; this is the company's own description, with no independent testing reported.
summary: Express Computer reports, citing New Relic, that AI Evaluation sits inside its AI Observability platform and uses a second AI model to score sampled answers and attach those scores to the application's traces (records of a request's path), so teams can tell whether a fault comes from the model, the retrieval system that feeds it documents, or other code. It also includes guardrails against prompt injection, jailbreaks and personal-data leaks, and links answer quality to compute and token costs.
notes: Read from fulltext. Press-release style text; company claims not independently checked.
